key_figures.why: connect garden geometry to route-network construction, scene-change score and final route
key_figures.supports: internal mechanism and within-paper ranking/optimization behavior
key_figures.cannot_prove: perceptual validity or certified global optimum/Gap=0 without external ratings or exact bound

key_figures.why: show how element distribution and openness components produce ranking
key_figures.supports: descriptive score decomposition under chosen formulas/weights
key_figures.cannot_prove: objective “small-in-large” quality because score scales, anchor and adjustment parameters are model-defined and not externally validated

key_figures.why: show pairwise structure, claimed commonality and external-garden extension
key_figures.supports: descriptive relationships under the chosen 20D representation
key_figures.cannot_prove: matrix-summary arithmetic when text conflicts with table, true cluster taxonomy, or predictive generalization without predeclared truth labels

figure_decision_rules: route map + objective table should be linked to the same route_id and final feasibility registry
score/ranking figures require algebraically closed component ranges and held-out/external validation
similarity heatmap statistics must be computed directly from the plotted matrix, not separately typed
cluster labels used in later radar/rank tables must carry the same taxonomy/version id or explicitly declare a new taxonomy
external-validation figures must state the ground-truth source and independent unit
